ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, what letter labels the respiratory aperture?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a boundary line on the left representing the body surface, and a horizontal respiratory tube extends to the right from a small opening on the left surface and gradually branches. The arrow labeled with the letter A points to the small opening at the left surface where the tube begins; C points to the main tube; E points to the right branch. Reasoning: The question asks about the respiratory aperture (respiratory pore/respiratory opening). The respiratory aperture should be the external opening of the respiratory tube on the body surface. In the figure, the one pointing to this external opening is A, so the answer is A.
